## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat:` New feature
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor:` Code refactoring (no behavior change)
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation update
- [ ] `test:` Test addition or update
- [ ] `chore:` Build / CI / tooling change

## Checklist

- [ ] **Tests pass** — `pytest tests/ -v` succeeds with no failures.
- [ ] **Lint clean** — `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` report no issues.
- [ ] **Docs updated** — Docstrings and user-facing documentation reflect the changes (if applicable).
- [ ] **CHANGELOG updated** — Added an entry under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` (if applicable).
